# examples/pokedex on every target, against PokéAPI as the script harness's
# server records it (cmd/sngl/httpserver_test.go, testdata/pokeapi): the
# example is copied in as it ships, and pokedex_test.sngl beside it points
# each page at the server through `poke.server`, the context its openapi:
# import declares.
#
# Each test takes a component wrapping one of the example's under the
# provider, so what it reads is one instance deep: a compiled test reaches
# into the instance its component renders, and no further.
#
# html serves the app in route mode (--lang go): a detail page is
# /pokemon/{name}, a pattern a static site cannot serve, which --lang none
# refuses where the page is written. The tests take components rather than the
# window, so html runs them as a static page each, from a copy holding the
# components without app.sngl's window.

cp $SNGL_ROOT/examples/pokedex/app.sngl $SNGL_ROOT/examples/pokedex/detail.sngl $SNGL_ROOT/examples/pokedex/list.sngl $SNGL_ROOT/examples/pokedex/names.sngl $SNGL_ROOT/examples/pokedex/pokeapi.yml .

sngl test --platform=none .
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go .
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go .
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go .
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin .
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

mkdir parts
cp detail.sngl list.sngl names.sngl pokeapi.yml pokedex_test.sngl parts
sngl test --platform=html parts
stdout '6 tests, 0 failures'

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=go -o site .
exists site/server.go

! sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none -o static .
stderr 'app.sngl:26:25: page "detail" is served at /pokemon/\{name\}, a pattern: a static site writes one document per page and cannot serve one'

-- pokedex_test.sngl --
import poke "openapi:./pokeapi.yml"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const local = "http://127.0.0.1:47819/pokeapi"

var opened = ""

component listed ui.node {
    poke.server(local) {
        listPage #page(pageSize=2, @open(n) { opened = n })
    }
}

component bulbasaur ui.node {
    poke.server(local) {
        card #one(name="bulbasaur", @open { opened = "bulbasaur" })
    }
}

component ivysaur ui.node {
    poke.server(local) {
        detailPage #detail(name="ivysaur", @open(n) { opened = n })
    }
}

component chain ui.node {
    poke.server(local) {
        evolution #evo(species="ivysaur", @open(n) { opened = n })
    }
}

func testTheListLoadsAPageAndMore(t test.Test, c listed) {
    t.wait(func() => c.page.names.length() == 2, 5000)
    t.assert(c.page.count == 5)
    t.assert(c.page.names[0].name == "bulbasaur")
    t.assert(c.page.more != null)
    if c.page.more != null {
        c.page.more.click()
    }
    t.wait(func() => c.page.names.length() == 4, 5000)
    t.assert(c.page.names[3].name == "charmander")
}

func testTheSearchFiltersWhatLoaded(t test.Test, c listed) {
    t.wait(func() => c.page.names.length() == 2, 5000)
    t.assert(c.page.more != null)
    if c.page.more != null {
        c.page.more.click()
    }
    t.wait(func() => c.page.names.length() == 4, 5000)
    c.page.searchBox.input("SAUR")
    t.assert(c.page.matching().length() == 3)
}

func testACardAsksForItsOwn(t test.Test, c bulbasaur) {
    t.wait(func() => c.one.mon != null, 5000)
    t.assert(c.one.mon != null && c.one.mon.types.length() == 2)
}

func testTheDetailPageShowsThePokemon(t test.Test, c ivysaur) {
    t.wait(func() => c.detail.mon != null, 5000)
    t.assert(c.detail.mon != null && c.detail.mon.id == 2)
    t.assert(c.detail.mon != null && c.detail.mon.stats[0].baseStat == 60)
    t.assert(!c.detail.loading)
}

func testTheChainIsTwoRequestsBehind(t test.Test, c chain) {
    t.wait(func() => c.evo.chain != null, 5000)
    t.assert(c.evo.about != null && idOf(c.evo.about.evolutionChain.url) == "1")
    t.assert(c.evo.chain != null && stages(c.evo.chain.chain).join(",") == "bulbasaur,ivysaur,venusaur")
}

// Takes a component as every test here does: on html a group of tests that
// take none builds the package with no root, and a component built at run
// time in it has no setter for the prop a reactive `if` hands it.
func testNames(t test.Test, c listed) {
    t.assert(display("mr-mime") == "Mr Mime")
    t.assert(idOf("http://127.0.0.1:47819/pokeapi/api/v2/evolution-chain/2/") == "2")
}
